purpose: M61 stale-seal refreshes: every record whose bbSeal envelope had to be recomputed because a producer rewrote its content after sealing. A row here is the written reason for that refresh — old digest, new digest, why, when. Written only by script/m61/refresh-stale-seals.ts and script/m61/seal_register.ts, and CHECKED by script/m61/verify-seal-audit.ts (each row's newDigest must equal the file's current seal, so the register cannot outlive the fact it records).
